applicabilityBasis.summary: Metronome documentation describes crypto-collateral borrowing and dollar-denominated synthetic assets usable in trading and yield strategies. It does not establish an identifiable legal issuer obligation to redeem holders for fixed national currency or a currency-denominated deposit as required by the GENIUS definition. General stablecoin utility leaves applicability genuinely ambiguous; CDP architecture alone does not establish an exemption. Synth-marketplace documentation describes design, not verification that swaps currently operate.

genius.notes: No token-specific public GENIUS authorization or announced application was located. January 2023 terms identify Autonomous Software as interface provider, not a verified legal issuer. Governance documentation describes staged decentralization, multisig implementation and retained veto/mint-burn authority; fully decentralized issuerlessness is not assumed. Synth-marketplace documentation is retained as design evidence without asserting present swap operation. No legal fixed-monetary-value holder redemption policy, issuer fiat-reserve disclosure or statutory monthly reserve attestation was found in the reviewed sources. On-chain crypto collateral information and borrower repayment are distinct from those documents. Treasury expects January 18, 2027 effectiveness; the September SCRC procedural IFR is not token approval.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of October 7, 2026, opened regulator directories, implementation publications, product disclosures and exact-name regulator searches yielded no public token-specific PPSI approval, GENIUS state qualification, official pending application, registered foreign exception or GENIUS enforcement action for Metronome msUSD. These are bounded public checks, not proof that every nonpublic record is absent. The OCC bank-applications table and NYDFS ordinary licensing list are not complete GENIUS authorization registers. Legal issuer identity remains unresolved, so undisclosed-entity records cannot be excluded.
